title: LPC for Forge
description: Fork of the popular LPC (LuckPerms Chat) plugin for Forge
body:
**!THIS IS NOT AN OFFICIAL PORT OF THE LPC PLUGIN!**
Basically a fork of [LPC plugin for spigot/paper.](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/lpc-chat-formatter-1-7-10-1-21-11.68965/).
Allows server admins to easilly configure chat format.
This mod is also compatible with [Discord & Chat Images](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/discord-chat-connect) for example.
This mod requires [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/) mod to work!
